notes: Landmark coordinates are Blender XYZ metres; Godot XYZ mapping is (x,z,-y).
mane_poll_side_endpoint is the actual poll-side Mane endpoint at x=0.515m; it is 17–30mm forward of sampled ear-root points, not behind the ears. mane_end_at_withers is the withers-side endpoint.
Bone joints and nearest Body projections remain explicitly distinct; lateral neck stations are direct Body ray hits, and the Neck_Base nearest projection lies behind the withers.
Foal remains a candidate; this evidence does not establish animation or production-anatomy acceptance.

The four morph descriptors were each checked at -1 and +1 with the Idle midpoint (frame 49), using persistent full sole-support vertex IDs and Body-barycentric forelock/tail root pairs; this is eight cases, not an exhaustive 97-frame-by-morph sweep.
anatomyLandmarkConfidenceNote: Lateral neck references are evaluated Body ray hits at stated approximate x/z probe stations with recorded face IDs and normals. Bone-to-surface nearest projections are explicitly projection-only and may land behind the withers. The poll-side Mane endpoint is in front of the ear roots on this foal. Jaw_Tip is a non-deforming semantic helper alias of the muzzle, not a separate anatomical observation.
